comparison.objective: Test two recessed spring plungers using a pin tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed axial tool insertion, pressing, dwell, and release verification.
comparison.success_condition: Each plunger depressed at least 8 mm, briefly held, allowed to return, and tool returned with grippers open.
comparison.reason: Spring-plunger testing verifies return but has no adjustment-setting or locknut operation.
